## What's new in 1.4.0

**Stretch to fit the screen.** Star Wars Screen Entertainment, The Far Side, Dilbert, Star Trek, ScreamSavers and Marvel modules draw for a 640×480 screen, so on a widescreen monitor they keep their 4:3 shape with black bars at the sides. A new setting, **Stretch to fit the screen (no black bars)**, under Resolution and Monitors in the settings window, makes them fill the whole monitor instead. The live preview shows the difference as you tick it. It is off by default, and After Dark's own modules, which already fill the screen, are not affected. Clicks and the Caps Lock games follow the stretched picture.

On Linux, the same setting is `longafterdark --stretch`, and a check box in XScreenSaver's settings.
